g.text: Executed reference traces: same success, different behaviour
Not native-agent results. One preselected world (omega_11); each arrow is one actual move.
Blue solid: other commutes. Brown dashed: trip containing unsupported processing. Numbers: movement order.
Grey: public roads. A wrong first attempt can reveal useful information; it is not automatically a memory error.
